title: Noise Disturbances from Relocation of Paya Lebar Airbase
what_it_is: Noise Disturbances from Relocation of Paya Lebar Airbase

sections.label: Paya Lebar Airbase relocation questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Defence about factors determining the Paya Lebar Airbase relocation timeline, flight times and frequencies, and effects on residents' noise and safety.

sentences.text: The following questions stood in the name of  Ms Sun Xueling –  14  To ask	the Minister for Defence (a) what factors determine the timeline for the relocation of Paya Lebar Airbase; and (b) whether residents in the northeast within the flight path will experience a steady decrease in loud sounds from aircraft flying past with the phased relocation of Paya Lebar Airbase. 15 To ask the Minister for Defence (a) what factors determine the flight times and flight frequencies of aircraft flying to and from the Paya Lebar Airbase; (b) whether there is seasonality to these times and frequencies; and (c) if so, how can the public find out more about the frequencies of flight times to plan their daily activities, especially when they have to take care of young children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Defence with the proposed expansion of Tengah Airbase to accommodate the partial relocation of Paya Lebar Airbase, how will the Ministry (i) ensure that residents in the vicinity of the airbase will not be affected by any changes in operations resulting in increased noise and (ii) assure residents of the safety precautions for training or operations with increased air traffic.

sections.label: Relocation timeline and freed land
sections.summary: The timeline cannot be fixed exactly now, but implementation will free up 800 hectares of prime land in the north-east region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It is a complex undertaking and, therefore, the timeline cannot be fixed exactly now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But when implemented, it will free up 800 hectares of prime land in the north-east region.

sections.label: Complexity of PLAB relocation
sections.summary: The relocation of PLAB is complex because it now houses one third of the RSAF's fixed wing squadrons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The relocation of PLAB is complex because it now houses one third of the RSAF's fixed wing squadrons.

sections.label: Flying training moved overseas
sections.summary: About 50% of flying training has been moved overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: First, we have moved about 50% of our flying training overseas.

sections.label: NEA noise study guides planning
sections.summary: A noise study by NEA will guide planning of new residential developments to minimise aircraft noise impact upfront.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: A noise study was conducted by NEA which will guide the planning of new residential developments to minimise the impact of aircraft noise upfront.
